2609.01426.title: Semantic-Guided Multimodal Preprocessing for Vision Transformer-Based Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Grading
2609.01426.paper_summary: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (CCRCC) grading is essential for treatment planning, yet existing approaches either analyze patch-level images directly or focus solely on nuclei-level classification, without linking to final tumor grading. We propose a semantic-guided multimodal preprocessing method that integrates nuclei classification maps from existing pre-trained models with RGB histopathology images for Vision Transformer (ViT)-based CCRCC grading. Our approach employs classification map channel concatenation and multiplicative modulation, with optimized overlays to leverage nuclei grading information, while preserving RGB textural features. Evaluation of multiple preprocessing strategies demonstrates that semantic-guided enhancement achieves 0.916 balanced accuracy, outperforming RGB-only baseline (0.707) and max-voting aggregation from prior studies (0.427). Sensitivity analysis reveals that this 21 percentage point improvement over baseline persists even under simulated perturbation at rates matching current state-of-the-art nuclei classification model error thresholds, suggesting both effective semantic utilization and practical robustness. These findings show that preprocessing-based multimodal fusion can leverage the diagnostic potential of existing imperfect nuclei classifiers, effectively bridging previously isolated fine-grained nuclear-level analysis with coarse-grained ViT-based patch classification. Per-class recall was consistent across grades (0.93, 0.91, 0.91), indicating that gains are not concentrated in the majority class. Because the sensitivity analysis perturbs ground-truth maps rather than predictions from an actual nuclei model, this result characterizes robustness under simulated error rather than deployment with a real upstream model, which remains for future work.
2609.01426.paper_summary_zh: 清晰細胞腎細胞癌（CCRCC）分級對於治療計劃至關重要，然而現有的方法要麼直接分析區域級圖像，要麼僅專注於細胞核級分類，而未能與最終腫瘤分級建立聯繫。我們提出了一種語義引導的多模態預處理方法，將來自現有預訓練模型的細胞核分類圖與RGB組織病理學圖像結合，用於基於Vision Transformer（ViT）的CCRCC分級。我們的方法採用了分類圖通道串聯和乘法調製，並進行了優化的疊加，以利用細胞核分級信息，同時保留RGB質地特徵。對多種預處理策略的評估表明，語義引導增強達到了0.916的平衡準確率，超過了僅使用RGB的基準（0.707）和先前研究中的最大投票聚合（0.427）。敏感性分析顯示，這一相對於基準的21個百分點的改善，即使在模擬擾動下，仍然保持在與當前最先進的細胞核分類模型錯誤閾值相匹配的速率，這表明了有效的語義利用和實際的穩健性。這些發現顯示，基於預處理的多模態融合可以利用現有不完美的細胞核分類器的診斷潛力，有效地將先前孤立的細粒度核級分析與粗粒度的基於ViT的區域分類橋接起來。每類的召回率在不同分級中是一致的（0.93, 0.91, 0.91），表明增益並未集中在主要類別上。由於敏感性分析擾動的是真實標註圖而非實際細胞核模型的預測，這一結果描述了在模擬錯誤下的穩健性，而非在實際上游模型的部署，這仍需未來的工作來解決。
